about: Golden JWS and EMV sets exported from the Java build (Story 4.7, ADR-0027). See README.md. Regenerate with export.sh; never edit by hand.

verifier.rule: FUTURE_IAT when iat > now + clockSkewMillis; EXPIRED when now >= iat + ttl; both judged after crit and correlationId, before the certificate and the signature

payload-request.what: POST /pub/api/v1/loc/{id}: the payer asks for the payload

payload-response.what: the payee's signed payload; statusCode in the header and in crit

notification.what: POST /pub/api/v1/payment-notification: the payer's pre- or post-commit

notification-answer.what: the payee's signed answer to a notification (INTERPRETATION I-12); statusCode in the header, in crit and in the body; httpStatus is the HTTP status it came with

kinds.note: Java writes typ JOSE on everything it signs and reads nothing from typ; it signs no QR content, so qr+jws appears only as a re-typed notification.
